title: Charred Malaysian Sweetcorn Risotto
description: A creamy and flavorful risotto dish featuring charred Malaysian sweetcorn, inspired by Italian cuisine.
instructions: Heat xenial broth in a separate pot and keep warm.
In a large skillet, heat 2 tbsp of oil over medium heat.
Add charred sweetcorn and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add xenial broth, 1 cup at a time, stirring continuously.
After 20 minutes of cooking, stir in malaysian chili flakes and fried shallots.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, topped with parmesan cheese.
